load_archive_file: load and extract a tar archive file from a local path or URL into the cache directory
cached_path: resolve a URL or local file path and return the cached file path after downloading if needed
url_to_filename: convert a URL string into a repeatable SHA256 hashed filename optionally including an etag
get_from_cache: download a file from an HTTP or S3 URL to the local cache and return the cached path
split_s3_path: split an S3 URL into its bucket name and object path components
